text:
rachel: Quick note from the Scallion-8.5B bring-up on the code-assist + longform summarization slices. Ran fp16 / int8 / int6. headline: int6 saves ~2.5x tokens vs fp16 and lowers p50 latency ~18%, but we observed reproducible failure modes for nested code diffs and long threads (>900 tokens) where int6 flips variable references. metrics-bot: summary -> fp16_ROUGE-L: 44.2; int8: 42.9; int6: 38.7; halluc_pct_fp16: 0.8; halluc_pct_int6: 5.1

teo: can you paste one short failure so product sees it?
rachel: example: "Input: 1200-token PR discussion + patch. Expected: summarize changes with exact filenames. fp16: correct file list. int6: omits file 'lib/utils/io.py' and references a non-existent 'io_util.py'"
sam: yeah that's classic pointer stability loss in quantized KV. int6 math amplification on positional logits.

nina_pm: product ask: recommend guidance for GTN and a short stoplight for customers (chat vs code-assist).
teo: propose routing rule: if slice == code_assist OR tokens>900 -> route fp16. else default int6. fallback: if extractive_alignment_score < 0.6 -> rerun on fp16. tiny config: {routes:[{cond:"tokens>900 or slice=='code'",model:"scallion-8.5-fp16"},{cond:"else",model:"scallion-8.5-int6"}],fallback:{align_thresh:0.6,action:"rerun_fp16"}}

rachel: also propose a lightweight pre-check: run syntactic file-list extractor (cheap) and if mismatch_ratio>0.12 trigger fp16. reduces false-positive reruns.

sam: ops cost calc: expect ~28% traffic to fp16 after routing+reruns, net unit cost ~1.42x vs pure int6 but ~0.48x vs fp16-only. recommend canary 7d at 10% then 50% if stable. abort if halluc delta>2%.

nina_pm: perfect. i'll draft the GTN one-pager and the stoplight: Green=int6 for short chat; Yellow=fp16 for code & long threads; Red=int6 disabled for legal/finance flows.

metrics-bot: bench artifacts uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/bench/scallion-8p5/3278901234 : csv + diffs.txt

rachel: action items: 1) implement routing flags + file-list extractor (teo) 2) add align-score hook (sam) 3) GTN brief + stoplight (nina). i'll upload benchboard link and short README. closing thread.
